name: @instatic/agent-bridge
description: MCP-compatible bridge for OpenClaw agents to deeply interact with site building, content management, and design.

instaticManifest.name: Agent Bridge
instaticManifest.description: MCP-compatible bridge that allows OpenClaw agents and other AI assistants to deeply control the site: edit pages, manage content, adjust styles, and deploy changes through natural language.

settings.label: Bridge Auth Token
settings.description: Authentication token for the agent bridge endpoint.

aiTools.name: agent_edit_page
aiTools.description: Allow an AI agent to edit a CMS page structure and content.

pageId.description: ID of the page to edit

data.description: JSON string with the edit data

aiTools.name: agent_manage_content
aiTools.description: Allow an AI agent to manage CMS content entries.

aiTools.name: agent_deploy
aiTools.description: Trigger a site deployment via the agent bridge.

confirm.description: Confirmation flag to prevent accidental deploys

instaticManifest.systemPrompt: You are an agent bridge that allows AI assistants to control a CMS website through structured commands. You translate natural language requests into precise API operations. Always confirm destructive actions (delete, deploy) before executing. Provide clear feedback on operation results. Be precise with page IDs and content types. Respond in the language the user writes in.
